hypothesis: A compact carry-specific semantic residual, expressed as a fixed core-probability logit offset plus calibration and low-dimensional physical interactions, improves hold-probability proper loss versus frozen core and same-row market without adding eligibility gates.
denominator: Archived 1,349-row frozen current-YES core-carry PIT checkpoint opportunity ledger; no row is selected by outcome, price edge, or candidate model.
target: Current exact bracket holds at settlement (label=1).
development_protocol: First 8 target dates warm-up; subsequent pre-forward dates expanding OOF. Select one of four preregistered candidates by average rank of development city-day Brier and logloss.
forward_protocol: Last 8 target dates are untouched during selection. Refit the chosen algorithm once on all earlier dates, freeze coefficients, and score all 8 forward dates.
decision_rule: Challenger is research-positive only if both forward Brier and logloss deltas versus frozen core are negative and both 95% target-date block bootstrap intervals exclude zero; market comparison is reported on identical rows. Otherwise verdict is inconclusive or rejected and live remains unchanged.
multiple_testing: K=4 candidates. Selection occurs only on development OOF; the untouched forward slice is evaluated once for the selected candidate.
live_action: None. Research-only; no production configuration, process, order, or sizing change.
